basic_info.description: This 3-unit property blends architectural charm with lifestyle versatility and strong income potential. The vacant 2BD/1BA owner's unit features an open-concept layout, private deck with garden + city views, a spacious primary suite with fireplace, two bonus rooms, and garage access allowing for one-car with interior access to the unit. Upstairs, a tenant-occupied studio enjoys its own deck; below, a 1BD/1BA unit at market rent offers a private entrance and exclusive garden access. Shared laundry, individual storage, and unbeatable access to Alamo Square, Bi-Rite, and NOPA dining round out this incredible opportunity.
